regime.label: Dealer short-gamma squeeze coils spot between the 1070 put support and the static 1080 call wall
evidence: Cumulative net GEX stays negative from the 910 floor all the way to the 1100 strike and only turns positive at 1110 - spot at 1073.0 sits 37 points inside short-gamma territory below that flip.

The 1080 call wall has held 1,841-1,906 contracts essentially unchanged for 5 straight sessions even as spot closed the gap from 3.8% away (07-09) to 0.65% away today - a live, still-untested resistance on the week's heaviest call volume (345 lots).

Put OI at the 1070 strike jumped 21.0% overnight (901 to 1,069 contracts, 231 lots of volume) to sit directly under spot, while total put OI is up 41.5% over 5 sessions (12,370 to 17,505) versus only 13.3% for calls (10,133 to 11,481).

ATM IV compressed for a 5th straight session to 13.77% (from 15.03% on 07-09, -8.4%) even as the future rallied 32.6 points (+3.1%) - vol crush into strength, consistent with a coiling range rather than an already-running short-gamma chase.

S50U26.today_summary: S50U26 closed 1073.0 on 07-15, +3.2 points (+0.30%) on the session, now just 0.65% under the 1080 call wall that has held 1,841-1,906 contracts unchanged for five straight sessions. Put OI at the 1070 strike surged 21.0% day-over-day (901 to 1,069 contracts, 231 lots of volume), turning yesterday's near-ATM strike into a live support directly beneath spot. Total put OI of 17,505 versus call OI of 11,481 lifts the P/C OI ratio to a fresh 5-day high of 1.52 (vol ratio 1.45), while ATM IV compressed to 13.77% - a fifth consecutive daily decline. Net dealer GEX stays negative from 910 through 1100 and flips positive only at 1110, so dealers remain short gamma directly under spot.
what_changed: Zone shifts from Protection (07-14) to Squeeze today: the near-put wall jumped 1050 to 1070 (+20, now essentially at-the-money) while the static 1080 call wall narrowed to 0.65% away from 0.9% - spot is now sandwiched between two live, close-in strikes rather than sitting mid-range.
Max pain drifted +10 points to 1060 (from 1050), a fourth straight up-day for the pain strike, but the gap to spot widened to 13 points as price (+3.2) outran the pain magnet.
ATM IV fell to 13.77% from 14.40% (-0.63pt, -4.4% day-over-day) - the fifth straight session of compression (15.03% on 07-09).
1080 call wall OI eased to 1,841 from 1,906 (-3.4%) on the week's heaviest call volume (345 lots) - profit-taking into resistance rather than fresh wall-building.
S50U26.five_day_thesis: Over five sessions (07-09 to 07-15) the S50U26 future rallied 32.6 points (1040.4 to 1073.0, +3.1%) while ATM IV compressed 15.03% to 13.77% (-1.26pt, -8.4%) - a rally into falling vol, not a fear spike. Max pain tracked higher but lagged, drifting 1040 to 1060 (+20) as spot pulled 13 points ahead of it. Total put OI grew 12,370 to 17,505 (+41.5%) far faster than call OI's 10,133 to 11,481 (+13.3%), lifting the P/C OI ratio from 1.22 to 1.52 - protective put demand building alongside the rally, not bearish conviction. The 1080 call wall has been the one static feature all week (1,844-1,906 contracts, essentially unchanged) while the near-money put support migrated up in lockstep with price (1000 to 1050 to 1040 to 1050 to 1070), so spot is now boxed inside a narrowing band under a wall it has not yet tested with size. Net GEX stayed negative under 1100 all week, meaning dealers have been short gamma throughout the rally - the move up was chased, not faded, which is why the setup reads as Squeeze rather than Pinning despite 76 days still on the clock.

strategies.name: Call debit spread 1080C / 1110C
strategies.rationale: Short gamma below the 1110 flip means a confirmed break of the static 1080 call wall (unchanged at 1,841-1,906 OI all week, today's vol the week's high at 345) forces dealers to buy into strength, accelerating price toward the flip - a defined-risk way to ride the squeeze without selling premium into a rally.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = net debit paid (last-price debit approx 13.7 pts x 200 baht/pt = approx 2,740 baht per spread); wing width 30 points.
strategies.invalidation: A daily close back below 1070 (the live near-money put support) negates the breakout thesis.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 1070P / 1040P
strategies.rationale: Put OI at 1070 built 21.0% overnight (vol 231) while total put OI is up 41.5% over five sessions versus 13.3% for calls, signalling protection demand under the rally; short gamma below 1100 means a breakdown through 1070 would also accelerate toward max pain (1060) and the deep 910 structural floor.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = net debit paid (last-price debit approx 9.4 pts x 200 baht/pt = approx 1,880 baht per spread); wing width 30 points.
strategies.invalidation: A daily close back above 1080 (the call wall) negates the breakdown thesis.

S50U26.prediction: Base case: spot (1073.0) stays coiled inside the 1070-1080 band - 1-sigma is only 9.31 points, so a single ordinary session keeps price inside roughly 1064-1082 without a confirmed break. A close through 1080 on rising volume (today already 345 lots, the week's high) would trigger short-gamma chasing toward the 1110 flip; a close back through 1070 sends price toward max pain at 1060 and eventually the deep 910 structural put floor. Invalidation for the range view is a daily close outside 1070-1080 with volume confirmation; at 76 DTE, treat directional conviction as low.
S50U26.risk_note: Educational analysis only - not trade advice, and nothing here should be read as a signal to execute a position. SET50 index options are cash-settled on the index with no physical delivery, so any pull toward the 1070/1080 boundary, max pain (1060), or the 1110 gamma flip is a tendency, not a guarantee, and the dealer-hedging mechanics behind it are structurally weaker than for physically-settled single stocks. This series is 76 days from expiry with OI still building fast (put OI +41.5% over 5 sessions), so directional conviction should stay low, and defined-risk structures still carry their full stated max loss.
